subject: English
learningObjectives: Learn how animals survive in deserts (Camels, Snakes, Gerbils)
misconceptions: Camels store water in their humps (it is fat!)

practiceExercises.question: How many litres of water can a thirsty camel drink in ten minutes?
practiceExercises.explanation: A camel can drink about 30 gallons (100 litres) in just 10 mins.

flashcards.back: A poisonous lizard found in American deserts

revisionNotes: Deserts are not just sand; they have a rich variety of life. Everyone has worries.
commonMistakes: Thinking snakes can hear (they feel vibrations)
